question: In which of the following years was Muslim League founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1906.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Muslim League:-**

 
 
• **It was founded in the year 1906.**
 
• The main **objective of the Muslim League was to safeguard the political rights and interests of Muslims in India.**
 
• The founder of the Muslim League was Nawab Salimullah Khan, who was a prominent Muslim leader from Bengal.
 
• The Muslim League played a significant role in the Indian independence movement and was instrumental in the creation of Pakistan in 1947.
